##### Descripción del producto

LEADEX V Platinum PRO series PSU is 80PLUS Platinum certified with 100% fully modular cable design. Smallest 1000W ATX power supply in the market with a length of 130mm. Patented 9-Pin Super Connector which allows CPU / PCI-E / SATA and Molex cables to plug into any of the universal sockets. Ultra-flexible flat ribbon cables which maximize PSU best cable routing solution. 12cm FDB fan provides accurate RPM thus minimizing the noise (dBA).

♦ Exclusive Patent Transformer With Innovative Engineering Technology Which Offers Superb Output Performance. ♦ Synchronous Rectifier Microminiaturization (SRM) Revolutionary Technology By Microminiaturize The Traditional 12V Synchronous Rectifier Into One Small Card Onto The Transformer. ♦ Innovative technology patents that combine transformers with proprietary SRM technology improve performance and minimize dimensions. ♦ Shorten its size to 130mm with no reduced performance.

- 1000W size 180mm==>130mm
- 750W / 850W size 165mm==>130mm

♦ Intelligent Recognition Dual Over Power Protection. ♦ 120mm F.D.B PWM Fan:Unique 11-blade design for high airflow and more stable cooling system, & PWM function provides accurate RPM thus minimizing the noise (dBA). ♦ New patented Universal SUPER CONNECTOR(Patent No.: Taiwan D196948 D196949 ; China CN304998083S,USA, Germany & Japan Patents Pending) Universal Super Connectors with patent allows you to plug CPU, PCI-E and peripherals freely in any of the 9pin socket provided. ♦ New patented technology of Buckle (20+4) Pin connector. (Patent No.: Taiwan M563575 ; China 7566010,USA, Germany & Japan Patents Pending) ♦ Innovative Design for gaming System & PSU protection. 1. DC output +12V/ +5V/ +3.3V remain stable. 2. Dynamic loading (Transient response) improvement on +12V/+5V/+3.3V. 3. +12V Output With Exceptional Low Ripple Measurements. 4. Dual Over Power Protection. ♦ ECO-design 1. Auto & ECO Fan control 2. High efficiency on all rails, including 5VSB ♦ Full modular design with all ribbon cables to maximize flexibility. ♦ 80 PLUS® Platinum Certified,90% 92% 89% Efficiency At 20% 50% 100% Rated Load. ♦ 100% Japanese 105°C Capacitors (Main Board & Modular Backpanel). ♦ Full Range Auto Voltage Detection Design 100V~240V (Active PFC). ♦ Comply With ATX 12V v2.52 & EPS 12V. v2.92 Specification. ♦ Comply With Energy Star Standard & EuP (Energy Using Products) Regulation. ♦ Over Voltage Protection / Over Current Protection / Dual Over Power Protection / Short Circuit Protection / Under Voltage Protection / Over Temperature Protection / No Load Operation / Surge & Inrush Protection. ♦ Support All Intel / AMD Multi-Core CPU & ATX / BTX Compatible Motherboards(Haswell ready). ♦ Support NVIDIA® SLI™ & ATI CrossFireX™ High Performance Graphic Card. ♦ More than 2,000 times On/Off test. ♦ Lead-free Green Materials with RoHS / WEEE Compliance. ♦ Perfect For Professional & High Performance Gaming System.

# 【News】 [內含台積電工藝] 振華 LEADEX VIII PLATINUM PRO PREMIUM重磅上市 

振華 LEADEX VIII PLATINUM PRO PREMIUM重磅上市 

知名電源供應器大廠振華電腦（ Super Flower）推出全新旗艦款 LEADEX VIII PLATINUM PRO PREMIUM 系列電源供應器（提供黑白兩色 850W、 1000W、 1200W共六款 ），更導入了由台積電代工製造的高精度 LLC 主控 IC，用料上再次進化！!

多重亮點一次看：

台積電代工 LLC 主控 IC，打造最強電源總開關

為了追求極致的轉換效率與電壓穩定度， LEADEX VIII PLATINUM PRO PREMIUM 在內部關鍵的 LLC 主控 IC 晶片上，特別委由晶圓代工龍頭「台積電」進行製造，透過世界級的先進半導體工藝，讓電源在高低負載轉換時擁有更精準的控制能力。

身材超小巧！小機殼也能裝進 1200W 

現在高階顯卡和 CPU 越來越吃電，傳統大瓦數電源長度容易擠壓機殼裡的理線空間。這款電源將機身長度縮短到只有 125mm。尤其 1200W更是業界極少數短機身白金牌電源，不管組裝大機殼還是小機殼都能輕鬆放入，組裝空間大釋放！ 

沿用 LEADEX系列日系電容及英飛凌 MOS管及內建諧振電感雙層主變壓器

採用 日系電容與 Infineon MOSFET，提供可靠效能、更高耐用性與長期穩定性。獨家諧振變壓器.能提供更穩定的輸出.並在電源內部散熱及空間優化上給予更佳表現。

省電又安靜+Cybenetics 白金認證

通過國際 Cybenetics 白金牌認證，省電效率高達 91% 以上。 ECO 智慧靜音風扇，在文書處理或看影片等低負載時，風扇會自動停止轉動，做到完全零噪音。

...

採用振華招牌的專利通用 9 針模組孔，插線時不用再死記哪一根線材要插哪裡，大幅降低插錯風險。本機種搭配壓紋線材，柔軟好彎折，讓機殼後方的線材整理起來更俐落漂亮。

重點規格懶人包 :

- 頂級用料： LLC 主控 IC 委由台積電代工製造
- 瓦數規格： 850W / 1000W / 1200W（皆有黑、白雙色可選）
- 機身尺寸： 12.5 公分長（ 125 x 150 x 86 mm）
- 支援標準： Intel ATX 3.1 / PCIe 5.1 (12V-2x6) 
- 省電認證： Cybenetics Platinum 白金級認證 
- 用料品質：日系電容
